title: Cytokine and Serine–Threonine Kinase Receptor Pathways
method: Unicode lexical count of actual saved p.teaching-prose elements only; excludes all headings, diagrams, captions, tables, practice, explanations, revision, sources and reader UI. Total includes visible supplementary article text and SVG labels, excluding SVG title/description and zoom buttons.

comparator.method: Inspected published exemplar HTML and reader architecture at initial HEAD; no 4.A immediate neighboring chapter available at review baseline. Comparable narrative scale and distinct mechanistic teaching.

scientific_checks: Official merged NET Unit 4.A printed page 5, separate NET Unit 4.B printed page 3, archived MP SET 2024 Unit 4.B page 3 visually checked.

Reviewed receptor-associated vs intrinsic kinase, JAK structure and productive geometry, receptor docking and SH2 specificity, STAT complexes, IFN-γ GAS and type I ISGF3/ISRE, common gamma chain and gp130, representative SOCS/PIAS/PTP control, TGF-β type II→type I GS phosphorylation, R-SMAD terminal serines, SMAD4 and inhibitory SMADs, canonical BMP branch, latent ligand, context-specific exceptions, nuclear localization and transcription, Drosophila and JAK2 V617F.

Checked Darnell/Kerr/Stark 1994, Heim et al. 1995, Wrana et al. 1992 and 1994, Alberts NCBI chapter, JAK and SMAD reviews; 16 linked source records. Original explanatory scenarios distinguished from historical results.

Separate internal editorial pass reorganized prerequisite sequence, strengthened receptor domain reasoning, improved 13 distractors, added detailed receptor complex and STAT dimer diagrams, corrected SOCS feedback topology and linked section-specific references.

academic_self_review.method: Separate internal author review, not independent external peer review. All roadmap concepts are developed; deductions for source-access limits, some conceptual schematics and overlap of reinforcement, scope of historical evidence, distractor depth and lack of rendered interactive tests.

limitations: Selected authoritative source records, accessible chapter and reviews checked; not every full textbook or primary paper was independently read.
MP SET comparator is archived 2024 copy rather than current independently verified MPPSC-hosted original.
Static HTML/SVG source and coordinate checks only; interactive browser/mobile and comprehensive accessibility checks not performed.
